assumptions: finArea_m2=0.03: plausible total wing+pelvic fin area, gives stall speed ~5.2 m/s
CLmax=1.5: typical for a fish wing, above operating CL 0.63
LD_max=12: moderate glide ratio, >= operating need
airspeed_m_s=8: above stall speed, equilibrium lift = weight (CL≈0.63)
flightMuscleFraction=0.25, musclePowerPerKg_W=50 -> powerAvailable_W=0.25*0.075*50=0.9375 W, above demand
cardiacOutput=1.5e-6 m3/s and arterialO2=0.1 m3 O2/m3 blood: give an aerobic ceiling ~0.75-0.9 W, above demand; units for these keys are guessed
notes: I could not run lean_check (no tool access), so none of this is verified. No blocking law is known. A possible risk: a ballistic-glide law might cap distance at LD*height (12 m) and flag 24 m. I judged that a powered flight is exempt from that cap. The units of cardiacOutput and arterialO2 are also guessed.
